mapper.sql: CONFIGID, CONFIGNAME, BANKCODE, INTERFACETYPE, ENDPOINTURL, AUTHTYPE, CERTIFICATEPATH, PRIVATEKEYPATH, PUBLICKEYPATH, APPID, APPSECRET, TIMEOUTSECONDS, RETRYTIMES, ISENABLED, ORGID, CREATETIME, CREATEUSER, UPDATETIME, UPDATEUSER
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_TREASURY_BANK_CONNECT_CONFIGS ( CONFIGNAME, BANKCODE, INTERFACETYPE, ENDPOINTURL, AUTHTYPE, CERTIFICATEPATH, PRIVATEKEYPATH, PUBLICKEYPATH, APPID, APPSECRET, TIMEOUTSECONDS, RETRYTIMES, ISENABLED, ORGID, CREATETIME, CREATEUSER, UPDATETIME, UPDATEUSER ) VALUES ( #{configName}, #{bankCode}, #{interfaceType}, #{endpointUrl}, #{authType}, #{certificatePath}, #{privateKeyPath}, #{publicKeyPath}, #{appId}, #{appSecret}, #{timeoutSeconds}, #{retryTimes}, #{isEnabled}, #{orgId}, #{createTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateTime}, #{updateUser} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_TREASURY_BANK_CONNECT_CONFIGS SET CONFIGNAME = #{configName}, BANKCODE = #{bankCode}, INTERFACETYPE = #{interfaceType}, ENDPOINTURL = #{endpointUrl}, AUTHTYPE = #{authType}, CERTIFICATEPATH = #{certificatePath}, PRIVATEKEYPATH = #{privateKeyPath}, PUBLICKEYPATH = #{publicKeyPath}, APPID = #{appId}, APPSECRET = #{appSecret}, TIMEOUTSECONDS = #{timeoutSeconds}, RETRYTIMES = #{retryTimes}, ISENABLED = #{isEnabled}, UPDATETIME = #{updateTime}, UPDATEUSER = #{updateUser} WHERE CONFIGID = #{configId}
mapper.select: SELECT BANKCODE as bankCode, COUNT(*) as count FROM TBL_TREASURY_BANK_CONNECT_CONFIGS GROUP BY BANKCODE
SELECT INTERFACETYPE as interfaceType, COUNT(*) as count FROM TBL_TREASURY_BANK_CONNECT_CONFIGS GROUP BY INTERFACETYPE
SELECT DISTINCT BANKCODE FROM TBL_TREASURY_BANK_CONNECT_CONFIGS WHERE BANKCODE IS NOT NULL
SELECT FROM TBL_TREASURY_BANK_CONNECT_CONFIGS WHERE BANKCODE = #{bankCode} ORDER BY CREATETIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_TREASURY_BANK_CONNECT_CONFIGS WHERE INTERFACETYPE = #{interfaceType} ORDER BY CREATETIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_TREASURY_BANK_CONNECT_CONFIGS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY CREATETIME DESC
